questions.question: A sum amounts to Rs. 6,120 in 2 years and Rs. 7,340 in 3 years at compound interest. The sum (in Rs.) is (rounded off to 2 decimal places):

Rs. 60000 invested at a certain rate for a certain even number of years, compounded annually, grows to Rs. 63,654. To how much amount would it grow if it is invested on compound interrest at the same rate for half the period?
questions.solution:
The formula for calculating the amount is A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

where A = Amount, P = Principal, r = Rate of interest in % and n = Number of years

In this case both r and n are not known but P and A are given.

We have 63654 = 60,000 × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Therefore (1 + r/100)ⁿ = 63654/60000 .

When the period is halved the formula for Amount A₁ becomes

A₁ = 60000(1 + r/100)ⁿ/²

Hence the multiplying factor becomes the square root of the original multiplying factor.

Hence A₁ = 60,000 × √(63654/60,000)

A₁ = 60,000 × 1.03 = **61,800**

questions.question: What is the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 46,000 for 2(2)/(5) years at 15% per annum, interest being compounded annually (nearest to a Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Principal amount (P) = Rs. 46000

Rate (R) = 15%

Time (N) = 2(2)/(5) years

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)n - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

The principal amount becomes

⇒ 46000 × (1 + 15/100)² = Rs. 60835

Now, for 2/5 years, the rate of interest becomes = 15% × 2/5 = 6%

Hence, the principal amount becomes

⇒ 60835 × (1 + 6/100)¹ = Rs. 64485.1

So, the interest accrued = 64485.1 - 46000 ≈ Rs. 18485

**∴ Rs. 18485 is the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 46,000 for 2(2)/(5) years at 15% per annum, interest being compounded annually.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

For the first two years, the rate of interest is 15%

Then, for the next 2/5 years, the rate of interest becomes

⇒ 15% × 2/5 = 6%

So, calculating the successive percentage of 15%, 15% and 6%, we get

⇒ {(15 + 15 + 6) + (15 × 15 + 15 × 6 + 15 × 6)/100 + (15 × 15 × 6)/(100 × 100)}%

⇒ 40.185%

So, the interest accrued = 46000 × 40.185% ≈ Rs. 18485

∴ Rs. 18485 is the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 46,000 for years at 15% per annum, interest being compounded annually.

questions.question: A sum of money amounts to Rs.28,224 in 2 years and to Rs. 29,635.20 in 3 years when invested on compound interest, compounded annually. What is the sum of money?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

A sum of money amounts to Rs.28,224 in 2 years and to Rs. 29,635.20 in 3 years when invested on compound interest, compounded annually.

**Concept used :**

If the rate of interest is r % compounded annually, then

Total interest for 2 years = r + r + [(r × r)/100] 

**Calculations :**

we know that compound interest in calculate on previous amount not on principle like simple interest 

So interest on Rs 28224 = 29635.20 - 28224 

⇒ 1411.2 

Interest rate = [(1411.2)/28224] × 100 

⇒ 5%

Total interest for 2 years = 5 + 5 + [(5 × 5)/100] = 10.25% 

So, 

Principle + 10.25% of principle = 28224 

⇒ 110.25% of principle = 28224 

⇒ Principle = [(28224)/11025] × 10000

⇒ 25600 

**∴ The correct choice is option 1.**

questions.question: Rs. 4,000 is given at 5% per annum for one year and interest is compounded half yearly, Rs. 2,000 is given at 40% per annum compounded quarterly for 1 year. The total interest received is nearest to:

Equivalent rate of interest for one year = 2.5 + 2.5 + (2.5 × 2.5)/100

questions.question: In what time will ₹3,90,625 amount to ₹4,56,976 at 8 % per annum, interest being compounded half-yearly?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principle = 390625

Amount = 456976

Rate of interest = 8%

Compounded half yearly

**Formula used:**

A=P(1+(r)/(100))^n

**Calculation:**

It is compounded half yearly, for 12 months r = 8%

For 6 months, r = 8/2 = 4%

Substituting,

A=P(1+(r)/(100))^n=456976=390625(1+(4)/(100))^n

(456976)/(390625)=((104)/(100))^n

(26⁴)/(25⁴)=((26)/(25))^n

From this we get n = 4 where n is in number of half years

4 half years = 2 years

**The amount will be obtained in 2 years.**
